brief: My wellness stack — 5 things that actually moved the needle.

slots.headline: What Actually Moved The Needle?
slots.subtitle: Five daily habits that rewired my energy and focus.

slots.title: Sunlight Before Caffeine
slots.body: Ten minutes of daylight before your first coffee. No sunglasses, no scrolling. It anchors cortisol and sets your circadian rhythm for deeper sleep later.

slots.title: Magnesium Before Bed
slots.body: Glycinate or threonate, not oxide. Three hundred milligrams calms the nervous system and quiets the mental chatter that keeps you staring at the ceiling.

slots.title: Zone Two Cardio
slots.body: Walk, ruck, or bike at a pace where you can nasal-breathe only. Thirty to forty-five minutes, three times a week. It builds mitochondria without frying your recovery.

slots.title: Protein At Breakfast
slots.body: Thirty grams within an hour of waking. It crushes the 3 p.m. crash and removes the decision fatigue around snacking later in the day.

slots.title: Digital Sunset Rule
slots.body: Screens off by nine p.m. The blue light and dopamine loops hijack melatonin. Replace the scroll with fiction or a conversation instead.

slots.title: Start With One
slots.body: You do not need six new habits tomorrow. Pick the lowest-friction win, run it for two weeks, then layer the next. Momentum beats intensity.
